description: Header file defining the ApplicationDispmanx class for Raspberry Pi 4, which manages display and input handling using Dispmanx, integrating with the starboard framework.

classes.name: ApplicationDispmanx
classes.description: Manages display and input for Raspberry Pi using Dispmanx, extending QueueApplication, with methods for window management and event handling.

methods.name: CreateWindow
methods.description: Creates a display window with specified options.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the application, setting up display and input.

methods.name: AcceptFrame
methods.description: Accepts a video frame for rendering.

methods.name: MayHaveSystemEvents
methods.description: Checks if system events are available.

methods.name: WaitForSystemEventWithTimeout
methods.description: Waits for a system event with a timeout.

methods.name: IsStartImmediate
methods.description: Determines if start is immediate based on preload switch.

methods.name: IsPreloadImmediate
methods.description: Determines if preload is immediate based on preload switch.

methods.name: IsDispmanxInitialized
methods.description: Checks if Dispmanx has been initialized.
